plan.title: feat(design-critique): front-door direct vs ingest — GitHub-only arcs skip occupancy, worktrees, and ingest

narratives.Description: GitHub-only design-critique arcs should skip occupancy, worktrees, and ingest. The front door is a run-posture field: direct is session:start --read-only (or release if already claimed), GitHub comments, SHA-pinned reads, family CLIs without worktrees. Ingest stays a later verb after the completed-arc record.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

The design-critique skill has one entry path. A parent that hears `arc 4066 yolo` still loads the mutation session stack: occupancy claim, optional ingest, worktree isolation for critics. Operators already run a second motion — GitHub comments only, no checkout lease, no ingest, no worktrees — and have to say "github only" in prose every time. That prose is not a mode. The skill should differentiate **up front**.

Two named modes:

- **direct** — forge-only. Issue comments, catalog chip, critic CLI spawn. No occupancy, no ingest, no worktrees.
- **ingest** — the current post-bind path. Completed-arc record, then `issue:ingest` / promote / build.

Invocation: `arc 1234 yolo direct`. If the operator says `arc 1234` or `arc 1234 yolo` with neither `direct` nor `ingest`, the parent asks which mode before Stop 1.

## Measured (2026-09-01, #4066)

Operator: `arc 4066 yolo on github only`. Then recut: `arc yolo on github only no local worktrees needed`.

What the parent still did on the first pass:

- `session:start` / mutation default (occupancy on the primary checkout)
- `git worktree add` for Claude and Codex critics
- critic prompts that assumed a local tree at `origin/master`

The contract is already GitHub-shaped: Stop 1, panel-deposit, critic comments, successor lean, verified-claims table, synthesis-accepted, `scm:issue:design-critique-chip`. Ingest is a **later** consumer of the completed-arc record (`evaluateCompletedArcRecord`), not a step of the motion. The skill never names ingest, occupancy, or worktrees — AGENTS.md session routing and swarm isolation fill the gap, and they fill it as mutation.

`#4020` is the session-posture twin (forge-only should not claim). It does not give the critique skill a front door. `#4066` / `#4067` are occupancy/spawn and panel-family dispatch. They do not split arc modes.

## Expected behavior

- Operator says `arc <N> yolo direct` (or `arc <N> direct`). Parent records `arc-mode: direct` on the Stop 1 write-back. No occupancy claim, no `issue:ingest`, no `git worktree add`. Critics post with `gh issue comment`. Panel seats still use family CLIs when N>1 (`claude` / `codex` / Grok spawn) against the existing checkout or ephemeral cwd — not a new linked worktree.
- Operator says `arc <N> yolo ingest` (or `arc <N> ingest`). Current path after bind: ingest is in-envelope as the next skill-exit instruction.
- Operator says `arc <N>` / `arc <N> yolo` with neither word. Parent asks **direct or ingest** before Stop 1. Do not default to mutation. `yolo` without a mode still asks, or yolo may pick **direct** only if that default is recorded in the skill — do not silently ingest.
- Skill EXIT for **direct**: chip + completed-arc record on GitHub. ⊗ `issue:ingest`. ⊗ `scope:promote`. Next line names "ingest is a separate operator verb."
- Skill EXIT for **ingest**: today's chaining into ingest/promote is allowed.

## Actual behavior

One skill, no mode field. "GitHub only" is operator vigilance. Parent follows session-start mutation and swarm worktree isolation unless the operator repeats the constraint.

## Proposed fix

1. Skill front door (thin): parse `direct` | `ingest` from the operator utterance; if absent, ask. Record the mode on Stop 1 (`arc-mode: direct|ingest`). Contract pointer, not a third charter.
2. **direct** prohibitions: occupancy claim/steal/grant, `session:ready` mutation, `issue:ingest`, `git worktree add`, local xBRIEF writes. GitHub REST + `gh issue comment` + chip verb only.
3. **ingest** remains the post-bind consumer path. Direct bind does not authorize ingest.
4. Panel N>1 in **direct** still uses family CLIs (#4067). Isolation for that spawn is "do not create a worktree," not "share the primary occupancy lease."

## Non-goals

- Changing ADR-005 / completed-arc ingest clearance
- Weakening same-round isolation or id ceilings
- Merging with `#4020` (session posture) or `#4066` (spawn occupancy)
- Auto-ingest after a direct bind

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `arc 1234 yolo direct` runs Stop 1→bind with zero occupancy claim, zero ingest, zero `git worktree add`.
- [ ] `arc 1234 yolo ingest` keeps ingest on the skill-exit chain after bind.
- [ ] `arc 1234 yolo` with no mode asks direct vs ingest before Stop 1 (yolo does not silently pick ingest).
- [ ] Stop 1 records `arc-mode: direct|ingest`.
- [ ] Direct EXIT forbids ingest/promote in the next-step line.
- [ ] N>1 direct panel still dispatches other families via CLI, without creating worktrees.

## Origin

Operator request 2026-09-01 after two #4066 yolo arcs that were GitHub-only by instruction and still grew worktrees and occupancy. Suggested invocation: `arc 1234 yolo direct`.

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-09-01T23:11:36Z)

model: gpt-5
role: critic

The direct/ingest front door can bind, but only if it is a session-local execution posture chosen before any mutation-capable session start—not a durable permission state of the issue.

**blocks-the-design — `arc-mode` cannot govern later ingest.** Evidence: at `fec1d758`, `assertCompletedArcAllowsIngest` accepts only the completed-arc thread record; it does not read an arc mode. The contract also says that, after that record, `triage:accept`, `scope:promote`, `issue:ingest`, and build may proceed and “any identity” may run them. Failure mode: a later actor either treats `arc-mode: direct` as an unsupported permanent ingest denial, or treats `ingest` as clearance despite a missing/invalid completed-arc record. Disposition: state that `direct` constrains only the current arc/session; preserve the existing completed-arc predicate as the sole ingest clearance, and make later ingest an explicit operator verb. Do not present `arc <N> ... ingest` as a competing pre-Stop-1 issue state.

**blocks-the-design — a skill parser arrives too late to promise zero occupancy.** Evidence: `session-start.ts` defaults to `mutation`; that path plans and persists worktree occupancy, whereas `read-only` explicitly returns alignment only with no ritual-state write. The thin design-critique skill contains no session/occupancy router. This is the gap exposed by #4020 and the observed #4066 path. Failure mode: a parent starts its mutation session before it recognizes `direct`, then correctly records `arc-mode: direct` after already claiming the primary checkout. Disposition: put direct-mode recognition in the invocation/session front door ahead of mutation initialization (with read-only alignment as the allowed posture), or refuse direct when mutation initialization has already occurred. A prose prohibition inside the skill alone does not bind this ordering.

**sharpens-framing — direct CLI critics need an explicit least-authority envelope.** Evidence: Stop 3 already treats embedded thread instructions as forbidden envelope input and requires the injection/swarm lens; #4067 establishes that direct panels launch family CLIs. Running those CLIs in the existing checkout removes worktree isolation while their prompt still incorporates untrusted GitHub material. Failure mode: an instruction-shaped issue/comment fragment or an over-broad critic invocation causes a critic to perform a local mutation, defeating direct mode without an occupancy event to diagnose. Disposition: direct envelopes should name the allowed operations and sources (bounded GitHub reads and the one comment post) and reject filesystem/git/occupancy/ingest actions; pass issue data as data, never executable shell text. This is an authority boundary, not a request to reintroduce worktrees.

Road not taken: make `direct` a completed-arc artifact that blocks all future ingest. That would conflict with the existing separation in #4057’s completed-arc evaluator and turn a session-routing choice into an irreversible issue state. The narrower session-local posture keeps the forge-only path real while retaining the existing, fail-closed ingest gate.


### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-09-01T23:15:31Z)

model: grok-4.6
role: critic

Open critique of deftai/directive#4072 at origin/master `fec1d758`. Target: can a `direct` / `ingest` front door bind, and what must change. Input ceiling: comment 5501669337. Audit targets: none.

The measured gap is real. The skill at `fec1d758` names neither occupancy, worktrees, nor a run mode (`content/skills/deft-directive-design-critique/SKILL.md`). A parent that treats critic spawn as ordinary parallel work will load session mutation and swarm isolation. A named chokepoint at `arc <N>` is warranted. The two-mode design as written cannot bind.

## 1. `ingest` is not a way to run the arc

class: blocks-the-design

Evidence. At `fec1d758`, skill EXIT is only "operator fills the brief template and dispatches the next envelope" (`content/skills/deft-directive-design-critique/SKILL.md:62`). It does not chain `issue:ingest` or `scope:promote`. Ingest is already a later verb: `assertCompletedArcAllowsIngest` in `packages/core/src/intake/issue-ingest.ts` (call at line 984) throws unless `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` is complete; the contract at `content/contracts/design-critique.md:453` says after the completed-arc record those verbs **may** proceed, any identity, same-session continuation not required.

The issue still packs two axes into one bit named `direct` | `ingest`:

- run-time: occupancy / worktrees / local xBRIEF writes
- post-bind: whether this skill EXIT chains ingest

Failure mode. Operator wants a GitHub-only panel **and** a story afterward. Natural utterance is `arc <N> yolo ingest` ("make this ingestable"). That mode reloads occupancy and `git worktree add` for the panel — the #4066 incident, under the other token. The mixed case the issue itself wants (direct EXIT: "ingest is a separate operator verb") is expressible only if they pick `direct` and remember a second verb. Naming the mutation bundle `ingest` teaches the wrong chokepoint.

Disposition. Do not bind two front-door modes. Record one run-posture field on Stop 1 (`arc-mode: direct` or a better name: `read-only` / `forge-only`). Keep ingest as the existing post-bind verb. Direct EXIT may say ingest is a later operator verb. ⊗ A mode that means "run the motion with worktrees because we plan to ingest."

## 2. A skill-only door cannot deliver zero occupancy

class: blocks-the-design

Evidence, re-run at `fec1d758`:

- `SESSION_POSTURES` is `read-only` | `mutation` (`packages/core/src/session/session-start.ts:124`). CLI/session-start with omitted posture is mutation (`session-start.ts:1200`).
- Mutation claims the worktree lease. Occupancy intent also defaults to `"mutation"` (`session-start.ts:786`, `session-ready.ts:203`). `--read-only` does not claim (`content/commands.md` Session routing #2176).
- Mutation boundaries include `start_agent` (`content/commands.md:415`). The PreToolUse spawn matcher lists `Task`, `SubagentStart`, `spawn_subagent`, `start_agent`, `CreateAgent` and applies the pre-`start_agent` stack to **implementation** spawns (`content/commands.md:347`).
- #4020 already names design-critique arcs as forge-only work that must not claim, and says: decide whether the unused `review` occupancy intent is the seam or posture alone carries it; **do not add a third overlapping concept**. `OCCUPANCY_INTENTS` is still `mutation` | `swarm` | `review` (`packages/core/src/session/occupancy.ts:108`); grep of `packages/core` at this SHA finds no `intent: "review"` caller.

This issue's non-goals refuse a merge with #4020 while proposed fix item 2 still prohibits occupancy claim/steal/grant and `session:ready` mutation. Two SoTs.

Failure mode. Parent records `arc-mode: direct` on Stop 1, then `spawn_subagent` / `claude` / `codex exec` for the N>1 AC. Always-on session routing treats that spawn as a mutation boundary, `session:start` claims `.deft/occupancy.json`, and the zero-occupancy AC fails. A field on the write-back has no consumer. Nothing in the skill or contract at `fec1d758` can refuse that claim.

Disposition. Either (a) this issue amends session routing so design-critique critic spawn is read-only / non-implementation (explore or ephemeral), and states that `arc-mode: direct` **means** `session:start --read-only` / no claim — which is #4020's routing rule, so cite it and drop the duplicate occupancy body — or (b) drop occupancy from #4072 and keep only the skill/contract recording of run-posture plus EXIT text. ⊗ A third concept (`arc-mode`) that restates occupancy while #4020 is open. The unused `review` intent is the existing empty seam; do not add a fourth.

## 3. N>1 "no worktree" has no execution root

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence. Swarm still says one isolated git worktree per parallel agent before dispatch (`content/skills/deft-directive-swarm/SKILL.md:104`). That is what filled the gap on #4066. Direct AC requires CLI spawn of other families **without** `git worktree add`, "against the existing checkout or ephemeral cwd." Critic method still requires re-verify by running checks against a resolved SHA (`content/contracts/design-critique.md` Stop 3). #4066 expected behavior is that spawned work takes a worktree, and sharing the primary checkout with a live occupant is refuse.

Failure mode. Codex `codex exec -C <cwd>` and `claude -p` need a directory. "Ephemeral cwd" with no git toplevel cannot `git show fec1d758:path`. Sharing the occupied primary checkout lets a mutation occupant change the tree while critics read working-copy files instead of `git show <pinned-sha>:`. Isolation today for this motion is the id ceiling (thread), not the filesystem; removing worktrees without pinning the read root makes the N>1 AC luck.

Disposition. State the carve-out in this issue (process-only critics are not #4066 mutating workers) **and** pin the execution root: existing checkout, reads via `git show <sha-at-dispatch>:` (or `git -C <checkout> show <sha>:`), ⊗ `git worktree add`, ⊗ occupancy claim, ⊗ tests against a dirty worktree. Ephemeral cwd is only legal if it is a throwaway clone that is not a linked worktree — say which.

## 4. YOLO without a mode is two instructions

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence. Expected behavior: `arc <N>` / `arc <N> yolo` with neither word → ask before Stop 1; yolo does not silently pick ingest. Proposed fix item 1: if absent, ask. Same section also: "yolo without a mode still asks, **or** yolo may pick **direct** only if that default is recorded in the skill." Acceptance criteria pick ask.

Failure mode. Implementer records default-direct because yolo means skip questions; AC checker wants a prompt. Or the reverse. The measured utterance `arc 4066 yolo on github only` contains neither `direct` nor `ingest`, so under a closed-token parse it still asks — unless synonyms are listed.

Disposition. Keep the AC: no token → ask, including yolo. Record that yolo does not pick a mode. Add closed synonyms for the measured phrase (`github only`, `github-only`, `no worktrees`) or accept that those still ask. ⊗ The OR in proposed fix.

## 5. Front door home is the contract and brief, not a thicker skill

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence. Thin skill is 63 split-lines at `fec1d758` against `MAX_SKILL_LINES = 80` (`packages/core/src/content-contracts/standards/design_critique_contract.test.ts:148`). Skill forbids copying contract bodies (`SKILL.md:58`). Brief template has no `arc-mode` field (`content/templates/design-critique-brief.md`). Rendered skill is pack output (`content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json`); `SKILL.md` is AUTO-GENERATED.

Failure mode. Parse rules + occupancy/worktree/ingest prohibitions + two EXIT paragraphs either blow the cap or become skill-normative content the contract tests exist to keep out. Hand-editing `SKILL.md` is overwritten on `task packs:render`.

Disposition. Stop 1 recording obligation + brief envelope field + skill pointer ("parse `direct` / forge-only tokens; else ask; prohibitions live in the contract"). Edit the pack, not the projection.

## Injection / swarm lens

This target changes authority, envelopes, identity, concurrency, worktrees, and shared state. The lens fires.

Untrusted input: free-text parse of `direct` / `ingest` from the operator utterance. `direct` is ordinary English. Deterministic control: closed tokens (and listed synonyms), else the existing ask path; ⊗ substring / NLP classification. Same trap session routing already refuses for assist posture.

Spawn / shared state: N>1 CLI critics without worktrees share a checkout and do not claim occupancy. A live mutation occupant of that path can write while they re-verify. Deterministic control is finding 3's pinned SHA read, not "critics will be careful." Occupancy grant/steal remains available to a parent that still runs mutation `session:start` (finding 2). Envelope injection: critic prompts that assume a local `origin/master` worktree will keep asking for `git worktree add` until the envelope field forbids it and names the read root.

⊗ Close any of this with reviewer attention.

## Road not taken

I considered treating `direct` vs `ingest` as two pragmatic bundles (forge-only stop vs today's mutation stack plus ingest chain) and accepting the name. That would bind only if those bundles are the entire product, session routing is amended here, and mixed "forge-only then ingest later" is always two operator turns. The non-goal "do not merge with #4020 / #4066" while listing occupancy and worktree prohibitions is what blocks that reading.

Steelmanning the issue: the #4067 lesson applies — the GitHub-shaped contract already existed and the chokepoint did not consume it. Putting a named mode on the `arc` utterance is the right door. What flips me to accept **this** binary: rename the second mode so it is a run-posture (`checkout` / `mutating`) not the ingest verb, point occupancy at #4020 / `--read-only` instead of restating it, and pin critic cwd. Until then the door does not bind.

## Can it bind

Not as written. Bindable shape:

1. One Stop 1 / brief field for **run posture** (forge-only vs checkout-mutating). Not a third charter. Not a second meaning of ingest.
2. Forge-only **means** existing read-only posture: no occupancy claim, no `session:ready` mutation. Occupancy mechanics stay on #4020; this issue cites that rule rather than cloning it.
3. Process-only critic spawn is not swarm Phase 2 and not a #4066 mutating worker. Execution root and `git show <sha-at-dispatch>:` are in the contract. ⊗ `git worktree add`.
4. Ingest stays `issue:ingest` after a completed-arc record. Direct EXIT names it as a separate later verb. ⊗ Auto-ingest. ⊗ Front-door mode `ingest`.
5. Missing token (including `arc <N> yolo`) asks before Stop 1. Skill points; contract and brief hold the field.

Until those land, `arc-mode: direct` on a write-back is a label a mutation `session:start` can ignore.

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-09-01T23:16:55Z)

model: claude-opus-5
role: critic

Open critique, N=3 round 1, ceiling `5501669337`, SHA `fec1d758`, arc-mode direct. Injection / swarm lens fires: the target changes worktrees, concurrency, shared state, and dispatch envelopes.

Re-verification first, because two of the three anchors move the answer, and this seat tripped one of the failures live.

## blocks-the-design -- the mode word fires downstream of the claim it forbids

`.deft/occupancy.json` on the primary checkout, read during this dispatch:

```text
intent:        mutation
claimed_at:    2026-09-01T21:29:26Z
heartbeat_at:  2026-09-01T23:06:18Z
session_id:    host:claude:v1:MDFhMDVlY2Yt...
worktree_path: C:\Repos\deft\directive
```

The Stop 1 write-back that records `arc-mode: direct` and "No occupancy claim" is comment `5501669337` at `23:07:21Z` -- 63 seconds after that heartbeat, roughly 98 minutes after the claim.

Evidence: the lease predates the utterance that forbids it, and `packages/core/src/session/occupancy.ts:1590,1602` advances `heartbeat_at` on any lease touch, so ordinary work in the checkout keeps renewing it.

Failure mode: AC 1 ("zero occupancy claim") passes vacuously -- no *new* claim is issued -- while the harm the Summary names ("GitHub-only arcs skip occupancy") does not occur. The tree stays leased under mutation intent, still excludes every peer, and the heartbeat keeps it alive for the length of the arc. A direct arc and an ingest arc are indistinguishable in `.deft/occupancy.json`.

Disposition consequence: the occupancy clause has to be a release-or-start-posture obligation, not a do-not-claim prohibition. As written the lean cannot bind, because the parent hears `direct` in a session that already holds the lease. That is the whole motivating harm, and the specified control does not reach it.

## blocks-the-design -- direct mode cannot execute its own posting path against a live lease

Measured in this seat, one step before this comment. The envelope directs posting via `gh issue comment --body-file <temp file>`. Writing that temp file to `%TEMP%` -- outside the worktree -- was refused:

```text
Directive denied Write: Worktree occupied by session host:claude:v1:MDFhMDVlY2Yt... (intent=mutation,
heartbeat 487s ago, no recorded write, claimed_at=2026-09-01T21:29:26Z ...).
This process presented session host:claude:v1:NjNjYjliODkt..., which neither holds that lease nor has a
write grant on it.
payloadRoot=C:\Repos\deft\directive effectiveRoot=C:\Repos\deft\directive
```

Evidence: the gate resolved `payloadRoot` to the checkout even though the target path was under `AppData\Local\Temp`, and refused. The four remedies it printed are stay read-only, use another worktree, ask for a write grant, or steal -- and this envelope forbids the last three.

Failure mode: proposed fix 2 says direct mode is "GitHub REST + `gh issue comment` + chip verb only" and bans local writes. But `--body-file` is a local write, and a forge-only seat running beside a live foreign mutation lease is fenced out of it. A direct critic seat on an occupied checkout either cannot post, or gets pushed toward exactly the steal-and-grant dance #4066 documents. The workaround is real -- pipe the body on stdin with `--body-file -`, which is what this comment did -- and it appears nowhere in the design.

Disposition consequence: direct mode has to name a posting path that survives a foreign lease, and reconcile "no local xBRIEF writes" with the temp file its own dispatch mechanism requires. Otherwise the mode is unrunnable in precisely the multi-tab situation that motivated it.

## blocks-the-design -- the prohibition list names no verb, and the verb already exists

Inventory at `fec1d758`, before proposing anything new:

| Mechanism | Location | State |
|---|---|---|
| `--read-only` parses on `session:start` | `packages/cli/src/session-start.ts:111` | exists |
| read-only start does not claim | `packages/core/src/session/occupancy.test.ts:1062` | test-locked |
| `SESSION_POSTURES = ["read-only","mutation"]` | `packages/core/src/session/session-start.ts:124` | exists |
| occupancy denial already prints the remedy | `occupancy.ts:459,472,480` | shipped |

Evidence: the capability direct mode wants is reachable by flag today, and is already the first printed remediation on a denial -- as the block above shows it printing, unprompted, to this seat. Proposed fix 2 lists four prohibitions (occupancy claim, `session:ready` mutation, `issue:ingest`, `git worktree add`) and no positive verb.

Failure mode: a parent reads the occupancy-claim prohibition, has already started mutation, has no named transition, and reaches for the recovery #4066 measured -- dual-probe, steal, re-prefix.

Disposition consequence: name `session:start --read-only` (or an explicit release) as the direct-mode start verb. A prohibition whose only backstop is the parent noticing is a safety case that ends at agent attention, which the critic method refuses on its own terms.

## blocks-the-design -- the forbidden-ingest clause contradicts the bind mechanism it rides on

`## Bind after accepted synthesis`, at `fec1d758`:

> ! After the completed-arc record is present, `triage:accept` / `scope:promote` / `issue:ingest` / build may proceed unless `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` returns `cancelled` or `unrecut-body` (#4057). **Any identity may run those verbs.** Same-session parent continuation is not required.

Evidence: the completed-arc record *is* the ingest clearance, and that clearance is identity-free and session-free by design. `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` (`packages/core/src/design-critique/completed-arc-record.ts:408`) reads citations, the latest lean, the table, and `target shape:`. There is no mode dimension for a new field to enter.

Failure mode: Expected behavior asks direct EXIT to post "chip + completed-arc record on GitHub" while forbidding ingest and promote. Both branches break. If the record is well-formed, clearance is granted to every identity the instant it posts -- a peer session, or the same operator in the next tab, ingests immediately and *correctly*, and the direct prohibition is a next-line style rule the mechanism never observes. If the direct arc withholds something so the record does not clear, direct arcs become unharvestable and the acceptance criterion contradicts itself.

Disposition consequence: proposed fix 3 ("Direct bind does not authorize ingest") asserts a property `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` does not have, and cannot be given one without reopening ADR-005 clearance, which Non-goals excludes. Either drop the ingest half of the front door, or restate it as parent-turn hygiene with explicitly zero clearance effect -- and say which, because "does not authorize" reads as a gate and will be built as one.

## sharpens-framing -- the motivating anchor is wrong about the skill, and what survives is #4020

Summary: "The skill never names ingest, occupancy, or worktrees."

The rendered skill at `fec1d758` names ingest, and bounds it correctly:

> Ingest waits on the completed-arc record, not a catalog chip.

(also `Parent chip write: scm:issue:design-critique-chip`). Occupancy and worktrees are genuinely absent -- but they are session-layer nouns, and their absence is deliberate: the skill is auto-generated from `packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json`, and `design_critique_contract.test.ts` locks it as a thin router with no normative content.

Failure mode: with the ingest premise removed, the residual gap is precisely "which session kinds start without claiming the worktree lease" -- the first Required behavior of #4020, whose motivating class is named there as design-critique arcs. Non-goals declares merging with #4020 out of scope, so the issue is one half already-answered and one half a restatement of an issue that is itself Blocked by #3873.

Disposition consequence: this binds as a skill-side pointer into #4020's routing, not as an independent front door. Take the dependency explicitly, or narrow the issue to the worktree and spawn half that #4020 does not own.

## sharpens-framing -- prose and acceptance criteria disagree on the path operators hit most

Expected behavior: "`yolo` without a mode still asks, or yolo may pick **direct** only if that default is recorded in the skill."

AC 3: "`arc 1234 yolo` with no mode **asks** direct vs ingest before Stop 1."

Evidence: the prose licenses a default the AC forbids, in the same document.

Failure mode: an implementer records yolo-picks-direct in the skill (permitted by prose), the AC test asserts an ask, and the build either stalls or the test is written to the prose and the ask never ships. The unmarked `arc <N> yolo` is the most-used invocation, and it is the one carrying two specifications.

Disposition consequence: pick one before build. Given the first finding, default-direct is the less safe reading -- it silently promises an occupancy posture the mode word cannot deliver.

## sharpens-framing -- dropping worktrees drops the revision pin, and the SHA field goes soft

Fix 4 replaces worktree isolation with "the existing checkout or ephemeral cwd."

Evidence: the critic method requires re-verifying anchors by running checks, and resolving SHAs from the tree. A pinned worktree supplied a fixed revision to run those checks against. This envelope pins `origin/master fec1d758` and directs reading through `git show origin/master:path` -- a moving ref. Measured now: `git rev-parse origin/master` is `fec1d758`, and `rev-list --count fec1d758..origin/master` is 0. No drift this round.

Failure mode: siblings dispatched under one ceiling and one SHA field read different bytes as soon as a peer fetch advances the ref mid-round, and the recorded SHA then attests to agreement over bytes that were never shared. "Ephemeral cwd" is the worse branch -- a cwd outside the repo cannot run the re-verification requirement at all, and a critic who cannot re-verify anchors produces exactly the citations-are-claims posture the contract forbids. Shared-state edge: N>1 direct seats in one cwd are separate harnesses whose own start paths touch `.deft/`, and by `occupancy.ts:1590` each touch renews the parent's mutation lease.

Disposition consequence: if worktrees go, direct mode must name the pin that replaces them -- dispatch `git show <dispatch-sha>:path` against the recorded SHA, not a branch ref -- and state that seat isolation now rests on the ceiling alone, which the contract already warns does not claim decorrelation.

## footnote -- axis placement

The arc's other selection axes sit at Stop 2, where the contract already ruled on a third: a target shape is not a charter row or a spend row, because a row conflates two axes. `arc-mode` is proposed on the Stop 1 write-back instead. Ordering justifies it -- the mode must be known before the claim -- but it splits the axis set across two stops when Stop 2 carries the written precedent. No disposition weight.

## footnote -- reserved line-starts checked

`arc-mode:` collides with none of the three line-start predicates in `completed-arc-record.ts` (successor-lean token, verified-claims-table heading, fixed accepted sentence). Safe to add to a parsed comment body. Recorded so the build does not re-run the check.

## Road not taken

I considered leading with "the front door belongs in the contract, not the skill" -- the contract is the source of truth and the rendered skill is locked as no-normative-content, so a parse-and-ask rule inside `SKILL.md` is a content-contract test failure waiting to happen. I did not lead with it because fix 1 already says "Contract pointer, not a third charter." It becomes blocking only if the build puts the parse behavior in the rendered skill rather than behind a pointer.

## Steelman

The strongest rejected position: this is pure ergonomics. The operator is tired of writing "github only" in prose, and a recorded mode has value even with no mechanism behind it -- precisely how `refutation-target:` works, a field that creates no unresolved-marker state and never blocks bind.

I reject it because the issue does not present itself that way. The Summary calls it "a skill front-door, not a docs footnote," and AC 1 asserts a measurable "zero occupancy claim" that the live lease above falsifies for the arc running right now.

What would flip the verdict: restate the acceptance criteria as recording obligations -- Stop 1 carries `arc-mode:`, direct EXIT prints the next-verb line, N>1 direct dispatches family CLIs -- and hand the occupancy control to #4020 and the ingest clearance to the existing bind bullet. That version binds today and carries no #3873 dependency. The version on the issue does not.

## Verdict

The ingest half of the front door answers a question the skill already answers. The direct half cannot bind as specified: its occupancy control arrives after the claim, it names no verb where one already ships, its own posting path is fenced by the very lease it claims not to hold, and its forbidden-ingest clause asserts a gate the clearance mechanism does not implement. Four blocking findings, all repairable without touching ADR-005 or the isolation rules the Non-goals protect.
